items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: he got me to work with him out in the kill. So, every Saturday, after I knocked on work, I'd come out here and we'd go out to the kill and play.

ctx.x: Well before that, I'm way ahead of my story. After with Paul Maurice. After with... O'Gees. As you... What's his name? August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. August. And, however, I played with him. And likewise, Sunder. I played with both of those. Sunder Labatt. Yes. Sunder Labatt. And with O'Gees. And after... I'd gone to New Orleans and lived a while. They would send for me from New Orleans to come over out here and play with him. Oh. Now Buddy Bo.

Edgar Benwell. There's a little story behind working with him. We were playing out in the kill. Kill, Mississippi. Uh-huh. Well, naturally I used to come up down the railroad. It didn't cost me anything. I had free transportation. I had to come out here. And, uh, he got me to work with him out in the kill. So, every Saturday, after I knocked on work, I'd come out here and we'd go out to the kill and play. So, it happened to be... One weekend we had a terrific rain storm, I'd say.
